## What's Changed
* Fix export bus texture (#8692) by @Mithi83 in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8702
* Fix Korean translation by @Mithi83 in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8935
* Fix: Re-check external container slot contents when splitting up a large extract operation to avoid duping by @Frostbite-time in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8734
* Fix jade compat of remove FE and Fluid tooltip by @Frostbite-time in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8799
* Remove neighbor updates from the Condenser caused by changes in the internal power level by @Vonr in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8934
* Use nicer number formatting for storage and co-processors in crafting CPU lists

## New Contributors
* @Frostbite-time made their first contribution in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8734

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/compare/neoforge/v19.2.17...neoforge/v19.2.18
